resources.string: Detects which app is in the foreground and applies the daily time limits you set. No personal data is read or stored.
Set a daily time limit for each app
Pick an app from the list below to set a limit
No app will be locked until you turn on Accessibility
Locking does not work without it
Otherwise the phone may stop the service
If you cannot turn on Accessibility: App info → ⋮ (three dots) → Allow restricted settings, then try again.
Tap any app to set its time limit
Choose a PIN of 4 to 8 digits
Enter the same PIN again to confirm
The PINs did not match, try again
Too many wrong tries. Try again in %1$d seconds
The daily limit for %1$s (%2$s) is over.
Enter your PIN to get more time
No PIN is set. Open Universal App Locker and set a PIN.
How long do you want to open %1$s?
Free and open source (MIT). No internet permission, no ads, no tracking.
Turn Accessibility off and on again, and allow auto-start and unrestricted battery (see phone tips below)
Menu names can differ slightly depending on your phone version.

1. Set battery to Unrestricted (see step 3 above).
2. If your phone has Autostart or Auto launch, turn it ON for this app.
3. Open the recent apps screen and lock this app so it is not cleared.
4. If locking stops working, turn Accessibility off and on again.

1. Settings → Apps → Manage apps → Universal App Locker → Autostart: ON.
2. Same page → Battery saver → No restrictions.
3. Open recent apps, long-press this app card and tap the lock icon.
4. If locking stops working, turn Accessibility off and on again.

1. Settings → Apps → App management → Universal App Locker → Battery usage → turn ON Allow background activity and Allow auto launch.
2. Battery → set to Unrestricted.
3. Open recent apps and lock this app card.
4. If locking stops working, turn Accessibility off and on again.

1. Settings → Battery → Background power consumption management → Universal App Locker → Allow high background power consumption.
2. Settings → Apps → Autostart → turn ON for this app.
3. Open recent apps and lock this app card.
4. If locking stops working, turn Accessibility off and on again.

1. Settings → Battery → Background usage limits → Never sleeping apps → add Universal App Locker.
2. Turn OFF Put unused apps to sleep.
3. Settings → Apps → Universal App Locker → Battery → Unrestricted.
4. If locking stops working, turn Accessibility off and on again.

1. Settings → Battery → App launch → Universal App Locker → Manage manually.
2. Turn ON Auto-launch, Secondary launch and Run in background.
3. Open recent apps and lock this app card.
4. If locking stops working, turn Accessibility off and on again.

1. Settings (or Phone Master) → Autostart manager → turn ON for Universal App Locker.
2. Battery → App battery management → No restrictions for this app.
3. Open recent apps and lock this app card.
4. If locking stops working, turn Accessibility off and on again.
